title: Draft catalogue (Spec 48 FR-48-92): sites/<client>/build/catalogue.json
description: The products a client draft's shop, product cards and product page draw, read from the draft code by lib/catalogue-read.mjs (intake.mjs --catalogue), and per site the WooCommerce product each became (site-build.mjs --catalogue --apply).

productBase.description: The single-product permalink base: the draft manifest's product route, else WooCommerce's default 'product'.

source.description: Where the records were read: the files holding the record lists, the product row's draft and the record field compared in the code's id lookups. Null when the page map has no live product row or no records were found.

facets.description: The filters the draft's shop offers on product fields other than the price, brand and categories, each a global WooCommerce attribute (pa_<slug>) the site build creates with its terms and assigns to each product as a filter-only attribute (lib/catalogue-facets.mjs).

dropped.description: Draft ids Bean dropped in the intake review (a catalogue row marked drop): the site build makes nothing for them and links to them keep the product-data handover.

sites.description: Per site (secrets name), what the last applied site build made: draft id to product id and permalink, and each facet's attribute id.

attributes.description: Each facet's global WooCommerce attribute id on this site, by facet slug: the attributeId a woocommerce/product-filter-attribute block of the shop's filter rail names.

photoToCome.description: The product carries the photo-to-come image (the draft gave none): `_sgs_photo_to_come` on the product; a real photo replaces it.

asset.description: Repo-relative path of a draft asset.

facets.description: This product's terms of each facet, by facet slug (term names).

key.description: The draft state key the shopper's choice is kept in.

slug.description: The global attribute slug, without pa_.

packSize.description: A pack-size axis (Spec 27 Part 2): _sgs_pack_size_axis on the product, _sgs_unit_divisor and _sgs_discount_label on each variation.

variation.description: Whether the attribute creates variations. An unpriced choice a choice flow asks (its basket call reads it) is an answer attribute that creates none, carried to the bag line by the flow (Spec 43 FR-43-7, FR-43-21); every other single-value choice creates variations, since the buy box draws only variation attributes.

variesBy.description: The Google ProductGroup variesBy axis this attribute is, written as each of its terms' _sgs_variesby_value (SGS's product preflight publishes a variable product only when one of its variation terms carries one); null when no axis fits.

field.description: The product record field the draft's filter tests.

key.description: The draft state key the filter's choice is kept in.

label.description: The attribute name: the filter group's label, a boolean filter's active-chip text, else the field's name.

slug.description: The global attribute slug, without pa_ (WooCommerce allows 28 characters).

kind.description: value: one text value per product; multi: a list of words; derived: a value a local function works out from the field; boolean: one term on the products holding true (the theme's on-off filter toggle).

wildcard.description: A field value the filter matches under every choice: a product holding it carries every term.

toggleLabel.description: A boolean filter's control text, when it differs from its term.

axis.description: True when a product attribute of the same slug already holds every term, so the facet is not written again.

draftId.description: The product's draft id, or * for the whole catalogue.
